annotations.text: Ledgerline — dark finance console. Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono, near-black layered panels, mint for positive / amber for overspend. Static mockups (no working controls). Sample data = August 2026: spent $4,182, income $6,200, Dining +34% MoM, Shopping +22%. Screens: Login, Sign up, Dashboard (with AI assistant dock), Mobile dashboard, Import CSV + column mapping, Transactions ledger, Categories & Rules, Reports / Cash flow (Sankey), Assistant (full chat page with conversation history).
